caption: A girl spinning on an office chair grabs the edge of the desk to stop, and her ponytail swings on around her head after the chair has stopped.

sa.check: A girl spins on an office chair.
She grabs the edge of the desk.
Her ponytail swings on around her head after the chair has stopped.
The grab comes first, then the chair stops, then the hair swings on.

pc.expect: The hair continues in the direction of the spin for a moment after the chair halts and then falls.
pc.fail: The hair stops with the chair; or it keeps swinging long after; or it swings before the spin.

pc.expect: The ponytail carries on the same way the chair was turning.
pc.fail: It swings the other way first; or flies straight up; or wraps the wrong way round her head.

pc.expect: The grab is what stops the chair: the hand closes on the desk and the chair halts.
pc.fail: The chair stops before the hand reaches the desk; or the hand grabs and the chair keeps spinning; or the desk moves instead.

pc.expect: The hair falls back down after swinging.
pc.fail: It hangs out sideways; or rises; or stays horizontal.

pc.expect: One girl and one chair keep their number and shape.
pc.fail: The hair detaches; or a second girl appears; or she merges with the chair.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: Her clothing, the chair and the desk stay the same.
pc.fail: Her clothing changes colour; or the chair changes; or the desk rearranges.

note: Inertia scene: the girl is kept because her hair is what carries the momentum. Her expression is not judged.
